limitations: Text-only prefill and final-logit extraction; mixed generation and multimodal embedding integration are not implemented here.
Static request groups validate sequence isolation and output mapping; this is not a production continuous-batching scheduler.
One owner calls decode and copies outputs; no concurrent calls on the same context.
Batch shape can change floating-point results. Exact probability equality is not required.
Elapsed times include vocabulary probability statistics and shared-GPU activity; not a production speedup benchmark.
Confidence thresholds are not batch invariant: recorded gate changes are measured using threshold 0.8 and margin 0.2.
interpretation: One model and one context evaluated up to four independent sequences in each decode and produced up to four final logit rows simultaneously.
All parallel and reordered candidate argmax choices match isolated choices; confidence gate decisions do change and need calibration.
This prototype proves prompt-only concurrent scoring via libllama. The production scheduler, token generation and multimodal integration remain separate implementation work.
